page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc8i.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 6462C processors running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, which provides a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage volumes. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, supporting high-throughput network communication. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that the 32 vCPUs are not shared with other tenants, offering consistent compute performance.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance suitable for compute-heavy workloads where memory requirements are modest, avoiding the cost of unutilized RAM. It is suited for workloads such as high-performance web serving, batch processing, compute-intensive simulations, and CI/CD pipelines.
